architecture: Shared contract across slack.rs/telegram.rs/discord.rs: HTTP or WebSocket platform client + pure incoming_from_* parser + ChannelApi impl feeding channel::Bridge; sends split under platform char caps with one Retry-After-honoring retry; inbound has liveness timeouts and reconnect loops.

files.description: Slack channel adapter (Socket Mode WS + Web API)

summary: Phase 1 audit of src/slack.rs, src/telegram.rs, src/discord.rs: 3 defect candidates (1 Medium Telegram data-loss, 1 Medium Discord identify-quota exhaustion, 1 Low Slack dedup-clear duplication), plus verified-clean items (token sanitization, 429/Retry-After handling, timeouts, unstable-API suspicion disproven via cargo check).
